name: Magna Buff

features.text: Designed for use on base-coat/clearcoat finishes.
Excellent for removing wet-sanding marks on new paint.

description: A semi-viscous, cream designed specifically as a buffing compound for basecoat clearcoat systems and is body shop safe. It removes heavy scratches, blemishes, and factory-paint defects on basecoat clearcoat painted finishes. For best results, Magna Buff® should be followed with a glaze.
application: Directions: For best results, surface should be clean, cool and out of direct sunlight. Shake container well before using. Note: applying excessive pressure while buffing may lead to "burning" or permanent damage to the paint. Hand use: Apply a generous amount of Magna Buff ® onto a soft cloth and apply to small sections of paint using medium pressure in an overlapping, Circular motion until scratches and blemishes disappear. Machine use: Apply Magna Buff ® to the painted Surface and buff while product is wet using a High-speed polisher and wool pad (do not exceed 2000 rpm) or flex polisher and foam pad (speed: 6). Repeat until surface imperfections are removed
